entries.title: Skim asks what you are skimming for
entries.body: Press Edit on the Reading for line in Skim and a box asks what you are skimming for; your answer is saved with the article and the route is planned around it. Newly planned routes walk more stops in More than in Gist, and more in Most than in More, so each pass goes deeper. The AI is also asked to write a short map above each pass and to prefer shorter quotes.

entries.title: The guide saves your words without a button
entries.body: When the guide offers to save something to why you are reading or About you, and the words are ones you just typed, it saves them straight away and shows Undo. Anything reworded still waits for Save, and what is already in About you is kept, with the new words added after it.

entries.title: Chat is told to look beyond the article
entries.body: In Recall and Tutorial chats, when you ask how the piece relates to other work, what others have said, or what has happened since, the AI is instructed to search the web and link the pages it found. The guide is told that Chat can look things up, and to suggest it as a next step.

entries.title: More sits right after Summary on the bar
entries.body: The More button on the bar at the bottom of the reading view now comes straight after Summary, ahead of Diagram and Skim. If the screen is too narrow to show it there, More still moves to the front of the bar.
